payload.title: Implement user authentication module
payload.goal: Add JWT-based authentication with login, logout, and token refresh endpoints
payload.raw_markdown:
# Auth Plan

## Tasks
1. Create auth middleware
2. Implement login endpoint

tasks.title: Create JWT authentication middleware
tasks.contents: Implement Express middleware that validates JWT tokens from the Authorization header. Should handle expired tokens, malformed tokens, and missing tokens with appropriate error responses.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Middleware correctly validates JWTs and returns 401 for invalid tokens

tasks.title: Implement login and token refresh endpoints
tasks.contents: Create POST /auth/login and POST /auth/refresh endpoints. Login accepts email/password and returns access + refresh tokens. Refresh accepts a valid refresh token and returns a new access token.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Login returns valid JWT pair; refresh endpoint issues new access token
